name: queuemate
description: Queue assistance operations platform for Botswana

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @queuemate/web" "npm run dev -w @queuemate/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @queuemate/shared && npm run build -w @queuemate/api && npm run build -w @queuemate/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @queuemate/shared && npm run test -w @queuemate/api
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @queuemate/shared && npm run typecheck -w @queuemate/api && npm run typecheck -w @queuemate/web
